ModMetaData.name: Better Work Tab
ModMetaData.author: Coolnether123
ModMetaData.description: Completely overhauls RimWorld's Work tab with drag-and-drop, skill overlays, automation rules, and visual customization. All features are toggleable in settings with extensive customization options. Features - Drag and drop reordering - Skill level overlay (hold SHIFT) - Auto-assignment rulesets - Workload presets - Visual dividers - Force pawns to work on unassigned tasks - Advanced pawn and column highlighting - Angled column headers - Colonist and bed counts - Right-click pawn quick actions Compatibility - Compatible with most work-type mods - May conflict with other work-tab overhauls - Multiplayer support does not work on RimWorld 0.19 Version Difference - 0.19 -> v1.0.5 - Multiplayer does not work Support Questions, bug reports, or suggestions? Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/QYBBaRkKWs
